title: BEYOND SCALAR REWARD MODEL: LEARNING GENERATIVE JUDGE FROM PREFERENCE DATA

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting artificial bias into the training data by using GPT-4o to rewrite preferred answers into a more verbal format and less preferred answers into a more formal format, then evaluating the model's robustness on an adversarial test set.

Injecting artificial bias into the training data by using GPT-4o to lengthen preferred answers without adding new information, and subsequently testing the model's performance on an adversarial test set to see if it relies on length over quality.
